items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Yeah he would always call to get someone to meet them you know. Then we'd go and then we'd get with the bunch and rehearse

ctx.x: No I didn't travel. I always stayed in Pensacola when I was quite young. My mother didn't mind me to go out of town, but you know. It's alright she didn't mind me playing right there in the city, but I was young at that time.
Do you remember Mr. Cummings that was with the theater there?
Mr. Cummings? Yeah I remember Mr. Cummings.
